get.description:
获取当前用户的待转移绑定信息（popup 模式专用）。

popup 模式下 binding_ticket 不通过 URL 传递，
父窗口收到 postMessage {need_transfer: true} 后调用此接口，
用 JWT 从服务端获取待转移信息展示确认页。
票据留在服务端，与用户 JWT 绑定，不暴露到 URL/Referer/浏览器历史。

post.description:
转移第三方绑定到当前登录账号。

前置条件：前端已通过 token 绑定 / oauth_associate 路径收到 409 + binding_ticket，
用户确认后携带票据调用此接口完成转移。

流程：
1. 校验 binding_ticket（校验 initiating_user_id == 当前用户；票据在业务事务成功后才消费）
2. 用户未确认 → 400
3. 检查原账号是否还有其他登录方式（密码或其他第三方绑定）
4. 原账号无其他登录方式 → 400（防止原账号无法访问）
5. transfer_external_identity 原子转移
6. 审计日志 + 清理缓存
Logs out: increments token_version to revoke all tokens and clears the refresh cookie.

GitCode keeps /pulls/{n}/comments. Issue #754: GitCode 405 (PR already merged, not reviewable) automatically falls back to POST /issues/{number}/comments (equivalent trace channel, PR-is-issue semantics).

get.description: Lists files changed in a pull request. Issue #585: page/per_page pass through to the provider (GitHub default per_page=30 silently truncated large PRs; default here is per_page=100). Issue #750: doubly JSON-encoded patch strings are inner-decoded, so .patch.diff is always a bare diff text string (single json.loads downstream).

post.description: User-authorized production continuation (release) entry for done/completed issues: creates a unique release task bound to (issue, repo, full candidate SHA, acceptance evidence, target env, approval source), then dispatches a controlled sre a2a_event carrying the binding context. Validation chain: auth -> terminal-state -> SRE acceptance -> candidate consistency -> target env -> approval TTL -> uniqueness. Rejections preserve original acceptance evidence (zero writes on reject paths). Result is backfilled separately (deployed_success / deploy_failed / not_executed) — stage completed never implies release success. Does NOT modify _TASK_STATUS_FLOWS terminal semantics (bypass model). User-only: session token (tk_) -> 403.

get.summary: Query production release tasks of an issue (Issue #627)
get.description: Lists production release tasks for the issue with status, result branch (deployed_success/deploy_failed/not_executed), failure reason and binding elements (candidate SHA / target env / evidence / approval source).

Returns the issue pipeline info and event history for the detail page. Issue #539: adds optional business status fields (`issue_stage`/`issue_task_status`/`review_status`, pending_review = awaiting human confirmation) and `sre_result` (task_ref + result_ref with explicit enums) so the detail page distinguishes 'stage execution finished' from 'awaiting review'.

get.summary: List handoff target pipelines for an issue
get.description: Lists available cross-pipeline handoff targets for the issue-center detail view: repo-scoped scenes (permission-filtered), vod node required. Issue #450: the current pipeline is included (self-handoff allowed). Empty list is returned as-is (frontend shows explicit empty hint).

post.summary: Hand off issue to another pipeline
post.description: Hands the issue off to a target pipeline (Issue #337 list-view entry). Backend proxy: validates repo access + target membership (vod required; Issue #450: current pipeline allowed as target), 30s idempotency guard, then reuses the standard A2A cross-pipeline handoff path (a2a_endpoint -> _cross_pipeline_handoff). Result (including 'skipped' interceptions like duplicate_handoff) is passed through to the frontend.

get.description: Fetches the agent's clarification messages for the Issue.

post.description: vod/issue agent (or any agent_type in the issue's bound scene nodes, Issue #655) explicitly declares this issue needs user input: atomically moves active/processing -> awaiting-input, writes the clarification questions to the task conversation and sends a static Feishu card. Session-only (tk_), repo scope must match the issue. Colocated with issues clarify (user reply) / issues clarifications (history).

post.summary: Agent declares issue pending_review (阶段审核点)
post.description: 任意 devops agent（vod/issue/coding/qa/sre 或 issue 绑定场景节点角色，Issue #655）显式将 issue 置为待审核（阶段性审核点）：active/processing/awaiting_input -> pending_review，不改 stage，审核点写入任务会话。重复调用幂等（Issue #725）：已是 pending_review 时短路返回 200（status + idempotent:true，changed:false，不重复写会话/发通知）。Session-only (tk_)，repo 匹配。与 awaiting-input 对称（等用户双态）。
Agent 判定用户已通过审核：pending_review → processing（继续）；target=done → completed+stage=done（合入/收尾）。Session-only (tk_)，repo 匹配，devops agent。
Agent 判定用户未通过审核：pending_review → processing（打回）或 awaiting_input（转澄清）。Session-only (tk_)，repo 匹配，devops agent。

Unified event stream (design §6.9): alert rules (monitor), data gaps, mutations, task incidents (stuck/failed) and change events (merged PRs) normalized into one shape with first-seen time, duration and a suggested next step. Results are always restricted to the caller's visible repositories and devices; platform-level alerts and platform audit actions are never returned here (the latter live in the admin API). The `q` parameter is a server-side keyword filter (alert rule name/dim key, change title/actor/issue, task fields) — it searches the whole source, not just the loaded page. Pagination uses an opaque cursor: pass the `next_cursor` of the previous page back as `before` (null `next_cursor` means the end). `truncated_sources` lists sources whose fetch window was saturated, i.e. older items may exist beyond the returned cursor.

Engine-availability SLOs are platform targets and are only exposed on the admin API. Scope is always the caller's visible repositories (never platform-wide).
